text:
Hi everyone,
I’m a Turkish-Swiss dual citizen and need to submit family registry extract and criminal record from Turkey for my B1 visa / immigration process to Israel.
Turkey can issue these documents with e-Apostille (electronic/digital Apostille via eapostil.gov.tr) as PDFs with QR code.
Does Israel (Ministry of Interior, Population Authority, or the Israeli Notary) currently accept electronic e-Apostilles from Turkey, or do they require physical/original documents with wet-ink Apostille stamp?
Has anyone recently submitted Turkish documents with e-Apostille successfully?
Thank you very much!
